name: Toolszu Link Shortener
author: Toolszu

sections.description:
The Toolszu Link Shortener seamlessly connects your WordPress website to your Toolszu Creator dashboard.
Stop manually copying and pasting your WordPress URLs into external link shorteners.
With this plugin, you can automatically generate beautiful, branded short links the exact second you hit “Publish” on a new post or page.
Designed for content creators, marketers, and SaaS users, this plugin integrates directly with your Toolszu account to keep your link management centralized and professional.

Key Features

  • Auto-Shorten on Publish: Automatically generates a short link in the background the moment a post goes live.
  • Custom Domain Support: Choose exactly which branded domain you want to use for your links (e.g., biopage.link, toolszu.me).
  • Customizable Link Styles: Choose between short & random codes (e.g., aX7b9Q) for social media, or SEO-friendly slugs (e.g., my-post-name-123) for email newsletters.
  • One-Click Copy: Easily view and copy your generated short links directly from the WordPress “All Posts” and “All Pages” list views.
  • Retroactive Generation: Quickly generate short links for your older, existing posts with a single click.
  • Live Link Preview: See exactly what your short URL will look like before you save your settings.
  • Local Reset: Easily “Unlink” a URL from your WordPress post if you have deleted it in your Toolszu dashboard, giving you a clean slate to generate a new one.

Notice

To use this plugin, you must have an active Toolszu Creator account.
You can sign up and get your free API key at Toolszu Creator.

External Services

This plugin relies on a third-party service to generate the short links.

  • Service: Toolszu API (https://toolszu.com/creator/api/links)
  • Purpose: Used to convert the standard WordPress permalink into a branded short link.
  • Data Sent: When a post is published, the plugin sends the standard WordPress Post URL and your Bearer API Key to the Toolszu servers for processing.
  • Terms of Service: https://toolszu.com/pages/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://toolszu.com/pages/privacy
sections.installation:
Standard Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Click Upload Plugin at the top of the page.
  4. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  5. Click Activate Plugin.

Configuration

  1. Go to your Toolszu Creator Dashboard and copy your API Key.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, click on the new Toolszu Links menu in the left sidebar.
  3. Paste your API Key into the configuration settings.
  4. Select your preferred Custom Domain and Link Style Format.
  5. Click Save Toolszu Settings.
  6. Start publishing!
sections.faq:
Do I need a Toolszu account to use this plugin?

Yes. This plugin requires an active Toolszu Creator account to generate links. You can sign up at https://toolszu.com/creator/.

Where do I find my API Key?

Log in to your Toolszu Creator dashboard, navigate to your Account/Developer settings, and generate or copy your Bearer API Key.

How do I delete a link?

To prevent accidental link breakage on your active marketing campaigns, permanent link deletion is managed directly from your Toolszu Creator dashboard.
Once deleted there, you can click the red “Unlink” (X) button next to your post in WordPress to reset the local view and generate a fresh link.

Why aren’t links generating for my old posts automatically?

The auto-shorten feature only triggers when a post transitions to a “Published” state.
To generate a link for an older post, go to your All Posts menu and click the “Generate Link” button next to the specific post.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Features automatic background URL shortening upon post publish.
  • Added support for custom Toolszu domains (biopage.link, toolszu.me).
  • Includes dynamic link styling (random aliases vs. SEO slugs).
  • Features one-click generation and copy tools natively integrated into the WordPress dashboard.
  • Added a local “Unlink” feature to safely reset the WordPress view after managing links in the SaaS dashboard.
